body:
## Why

A capability map nothing reads is configuration theatre. The worker's brief is where an intent becomes an
instruction — `src/context.js` already renders `kb.skills` as "Skills to apply: `/foo`", which is exactly the
shape, and exactly the thing that was lying before #114.

The constraint that makes this portable rather than a Claude-ism: **the intent travels, the binding is local.**
A card says its work needs a review; the `claude` profile says review means `/code-review`; a Copilot profile
says something else; a profile that says nothing gets prose. hkb must never name `/code-review` itself.

## What

- **The brief names the bound command** for every intent the card triggers, rendered in `src/context.js` beside
  the existing fields.
- **An unmapped intent falls back to prose** — the brief says what to achieve, as it does today. No error, no
  warning, no behaviour change for a board that declares nothing. This is the line between a capability map and
  a hard dependency on one harness.
- **`kb.goal` is the worked example**: every card has acceptance criteria and `hkb context` already prints them
  under a heading. A profile that binds `goal` should have its worker told the command; one that does not keeps
  the heading.
- Do not touch the launch's grant (a sibling's, through #255) or the operate procedure (the same sibling's).

## Done when

- [ ] A card whose profile binds an intent has the bound command named in `hkb context <n>`.
- [ ] A profile with no binding for that intent produces today's prose, with no error — tested.
- [ ] hkb names no harness-specific command anywhere outside a board's own config, pinned by a test.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Contract

Names a sibling depends on. Do not invent alternatives.

- **`effectiveTools(profile, task, board)` (#255) is the only place a launch's tool list is derived.** A grant
  implied by a capability binding goes through it. Never read `profile.allowed_tools` directly.
- The profile key is `"capabilities"`, an object mapping an intent to this harness's command:
  `"capabilities": { "review": "/code-review", "goal": "/goal" }`.
- `CAPABILITIES` is the closed vocabulary, exported from `src/model.js` and pinned by a test the way
  `EVENT_KINDS` and `GROOM_KINDS` are — a new intent cannot be added without saying what it means.
- **An unmapped intent is not an error.** It falls back to today's prose brief. That is what keeps a Copilot or
  Codex board working unchanged, and it is the whole difference between a capability map and a dependency.
- Portability is the constraint the design exists to satisfy: the *intent* travels, the *binding* is local. hkb
  must never name `/code-review` itself outside a board's own config.
- Read `hkb show 217` for the goal, and #114 for the instance this generalises.
goal: A card whose profile binds an intent gets the bound command named in hkb context; an unmapped intent produces today's prose with no error; hkb names no harness-specific command outside a board's own config, pinned by a test
title: The worker brief names the bound command, and an unmapped intent still falls back to prose
